mood.description: Transitions from Excited to Sad, then back to Excited. Initial excitement is driven by fast-paced music and visuals. The mood shifts to sadness when Copper and Tod’s friendship is threatened, then returns to an excited tone with Spike’s joyful demeanor.

narrativeProgression.description: Highlights the unlikely friendship between Tod and Copper, their separation due to societal expectations, and the challenges they face.

scenes.thematicElements: Friendship, loyalty, societal expectations, coming of age, and the challenges of maintaining relationships.

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Another family treasure is coming to video.
Walt Disney's classic The Fox and the Hound.
It's the unforgettable story of two friends Todd and Copper.
Two friends who didn't know they were supposed to be enemies.
Copper's going to come back a train hunting dog.
But growing up has led them on different paths.
And now their friendship and loyalty will face the ultimate challenge.
You can share this breathtaking story of friendship and fun.
So get ready to add this classic movie to your collection.
Walt Disney's The Fox and the Hound.
We will always be friends forever.

Cast:
Spike as Tod
Mushu as Adult Tod
Bambi as Copper
The Great Prince as Adult Copper
Twilight Sparkle as Big Mama
Nanny as Widow Tweed
Captain Hook as Amos Slade
Shere Khan as Chief
Donald Duck as Dinky
Goofy as Boomer
Ariel as Vixey
Philoctetes as The Badger
Olaf as The Porcupine
Pascal as Squeeks
Sabor as The Bear

Here's The Ohana's version of that favorite best friend movie "The Fox and The Hound" with special guest, first showing of Spike The little Dragon as Tod The little Fox and our little ohana hero, Bambi the little Deer with special friends like Twilight Sparkle as Big Mama, also her first showing, also the duo, Goofy and Donald as Dinky and Boomer, and to play our grown up Tod and Copper is our ohana Dragon, Mushu as Grown Up Tod and Bambi's father, The Great Prince as grown up Copper, we would've used Grown Up Bambi, but he isn't grown up yet (but seriously, there's barely any enough scenes of Grown Up Bambi to be Grown Up Copper, one of the reasons why we couldn't make Bambi fully grown up as Grown Up Rudolph in our unfished Christmas Special). hope you and your best friend will watch and love this movie, just as much as we loved making it
